node.title: v13 base-field normalization guard (ledger law)
node.statement: LEDGER LAW (upstream: przchojecki/rs-mca towards-prize.md (2026-07-01 revision) + cap25 v13 raw notes): prefix-floor and split-pencil entropy costs are normalized over the generated/base field B, NOT over a larger line/challenge field, unless an explicit transfer theorem is wired. PROVED as a convention+guard: any ledger entry spending |F| where the construction only earns |B| is invalid without a cited transfer. Rationale: prevents the false-proof class where extension-field size is spent against base-field-generated objects (the v13 margins are 3.1-22.2 bits -- a |F|/|B| confusion is fatal at that precision). | GUARD CONFIRMED IN THE FIELD (2026-07-07/08, catches #11-13): the M_B seam audit and beta-round found exactly the failures this guard predicts, in F2's window (q^t vs |B0|^t), F7's count law (K_cell/q^sigma vs p^sigma for base-valued worst words, census-verified), and F1's flatness clause (F_q-conditions actually F_p(zeta)-conditions). Statements corrected; evidence untouched. Guard edges added into the exposed reds per the 2026-07-08 alignment packet.
